items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: plus you bring in Bela Fleck on banjo

ctx.x: No addresses, I don’t like to expose that. I don’t want to do that. Know where I live, telephone number, knockin’ on the door.

Oh of course, but you are based here in the New York area. I want to talk about another project that I think is such a departure from when we look--I mean I had all my LP’s, all my CD’s out, but when the project The Guitars, because I think that one-because it’s such a departure from what you are known for and when you talk about guitar, that is going to open up a whole window for a bunch of . . . plus you bring in Bela Fleck on banjo. So how did that project come together? And it seems to have kind of been…
Yeah, I have forgotten the little details. I think Orrin had something to do with that, I think he was the producer on that project.
